    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">递归的编译优化(2)</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
		</div>
		    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        先从尾递归开始讲起，讲尾递归的优化，尾调用的优化，再讲到更一般的情况的优化。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:sql;gutter:true;">　　版权申明：本文为博主窗户(Colin Cai)原创，欢迎转帖。如要转贴，必须注明原文网址

　　 http://www.cnblogs.com/Colin-Cai/p/13752031.html

　　作者：窗户

　　QQ/微信：6679072

　　E-mail：6679072@qq.com</pre>
</div>
<p>　　本章接着上次的话题，继续讨论递归的编译优化问题。</p>
<p>　　注: 里面只是用Python来描述，以方便说明，内容是通用的。</p>
<p>　　先从尾递归开始讲起，然后讲到尾调用，再讲到更一般的情况。当然，本节的函数都是不带副作用的，也就是不影响外部状态，是数学意义上的函数。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　<strong><span style="font-size: 18pt">尾递归</span></strong></p>
<p>　　</p>
<p>　　所谓尾递归，就是虽然是递归的形式，自身调用自身，并且和其他递归形式不一样，尾递归最终是完全转换成了自身的函数调用。</p>
<p>　　比如，我们计算$\sum_{i=1}^{n}i$</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sum(r, n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> sum(r+n, n-1)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　然后我们用sum(0, n)来计算求和，这里求sum(r, n)要么归结为返回最终结果，要么归结于另外一组参数的sum调用，所以为尾递归。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　<strong><span style="font-size: 18pt">递归的计算</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　先从Fibonacci数列说起</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fib(n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n &lt; 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> 1
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　运行程序，解释器解释的时候需要事先给定一个运行栈，栈里每一层放置当前函数调用所运行位置、局部变量、过程中结果，用来作函数调用、返回时的上下文切换。</p>
<p>　　改写一下上面的代码，以便于统一上面的局部变量和过程中结果，从而便于说明。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fib(n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n &lt; 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    a </span>= fib(n-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    b </span>= fib(n-2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    ret </span>= a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ret</pre>
</div>
<p>　　简单起见，fib的运行位置涉及到函数退出或函数调用，从而切换函数执行的地方有如下几个:</p>
<p>　　start(刚进入函数)</p>
<p>　　return_1(return 1的位置，准备返回函数)</p>
<p>　　cal_fib_n_1(正在计算fib(n-1))</p>
<p>　　cal_fib_n_2(正在计算fib(n-2))</p>
<p>　　return_ret(计算完fib(n-1)+fib(n-2)，准备返回)</p>
<p>　　我们现在来分析解释器去执行fib(5)的时候，整体的计算过程。</p>
<p>　　我们的运行栈中每一个元素是一个(函数，运行位置，变量列表)的三元组，栈顶是当前正在做的计算</p>
<p>　　最开始栈是</p>
<p>　　{(fib, start, [n=5])}</p>
<p>　　假设栈的增长方向往右，那么接着的计算顺序是</p>
<p>　　{(fib, start, [n=5])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, start, [n=4])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=4]), (fib, start, [n=3])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=4]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=3]), (fib, start, [n=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=4]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=3]), (fib, return_1, [n=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=4]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=3, a=1])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=4]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=3, a=1]), (fib, start, [n=1])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=4]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=3, a=1]), (fib, return_1, [n=1])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=4]), (fib, return_ret, [n=3, a=1, b=1, ret=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=4, a=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=4, a=2]), (fib, start, [n=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=4, a=2]), (fib, return_1, [n=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=5]), (fib, return_ret, [n=4, a=2, b=1, ret=3])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, start, [n=3])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=3])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=3]), (fib, start, [n=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, call_fib_n_1, [n=3]), (fib, return_1, [n=2])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=3, a=1])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=3, a=1]), (fib, start, [n=1])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=3, a=1]), (fib, return_1, [n=1])}<br>　　{(fib, call_fib_n_2, [n=5, a=3]), (fib, return_ret, [n=3, a=1, b=1, ret=2])}<br>　　{(fib, return_ret, [n=5, a=3, b=2, ret=5])}</p>
<p>&nbsp;　　综上，我们可以叫它树递归，因为它的递归最终像一棵树一样，以上还只是对于n=5的时候，如果n=10,规模则庞大的多。上一节我们已经说到了。</p>
<p>　　我们本节不考虑树递归的优化。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　<span style="font-size: 18pt"><strong>尾递归优化</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　回头来，我们对于刚才那个sum函数来看看递归栈的变化，我们在这里重新写一下该函数</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sum(r, n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> sum(r+n, n-1)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　它一共可以有四个切换的地方:</p>
<p>　　start(进入函数)</p>
<p>　　return_r(执行return r)</p>
<p>　　call_sum(调用sum(r+n, n-1))</p>
<p>　　return_sum(执行第二个return)</p>
<p>　　我们来看看sum(0,5)的运行栈，最开始的时候是</p>
<p>　　{(sum, start, [r=0, n=5])}</p>
<p>　　接下来<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, start, [r=5, n=4])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, start, [r=9, n=3])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, start, [r=12, n=2])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, call_sum, [r=12, n=2])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, call_sum, [r=12, n=2]), (sum, start, [r=14, n=1])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, call_sum, [r=12, n=2]), (sum, call_sum, [r=14, n=1])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, call_sum, [r=12, n=2]), (sum, call_sum, [r=14, n=1]), (sum, start, [r=15, n=0])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, call_sum, [r=12, n=2]), (sum, call_sum, [r=14, n=1]), (sum, return_r, [r=15, n=0])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, call_sum, [r=12, n=2]), (sum, return_sum, [r=14, n=1, return_sum_value=15])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, call_sum, [r=9, n=3]), (sum, return_sum, [r=12, n=2, return_sum_value=15])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, call_sum, [r=5, n=4]), (sum, return_sum, [r=9, n=3, return_sum_value=15])}<br>　　{(sum, call_sum, [r=0, n=5]), (sum, return_sum, [r=5, n=4, return_sum_value=15])}<br>　　{(sum, return_sum, [r=0, n=5, return_sum_value=15])}</p>
<p>　　它的特点是在计算过程中，栈的长度先是一直增长，等到第一个返回出现的时候，一路都是返回，栈的长度是一直减少。</p>
<p>　　用过程的步数（也就是上面过程的高度）来代表计算复杂度，那么，也就是说它的计算复杂度与递归深度是一样的，这和树递归非常不一样，之前的斐波那契数列的递归，对于fib(n)的计算，栈深度是n的线性级别，可计算复杂度却是n的指数级别。</p>
<p>　　栈的长度关系到空间复杂度，我们其实没有必要维护这样一个栈，</p>
<p>　　于是我们灵机一动，换个思路，尾递归不就是不断在改变函数的自变量直到符合条件退出吗？</p>
<p>　　r=0, n=5</p>
<p>　　r=5, n=4</p>
<p>　　r=9, n=3</p>
<p>　　r=12, n=2</p>
<p>　　r=14, n=1</p>
<p>　　r=15, n=0</p>
<p>　　n=0符合退出条件，返回15</p>
<p>　　于是这就可以是循环要做的事情啊</p>
<p>　　一般性的考虑尾递归转换为循环，可以如下：</p>
<p>　　所有尾递归发生的地方都当成是修改自变量，然后整个函数体前面加上循环。</p>
<p>　　比如如下这样的函数是个尾递归，为了问题简单化一点，s只有一个参数，实际上多参数函数只需要传入参数改为多参数的tuple，就可以改为单参数函数。</p>
<p>　　例子中所有的函数cond1、cond2、cond3、t、t2都是随便可以替代的，分支个数什么的都可以更改。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(s):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
        retrurn f(s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(t(s))
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
        retrurn f2(s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> func(t2(s))</pre>
</div>
<p>　　变形为:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_circle(s):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
            retrurn f(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(t(s))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
            retrurn f2(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> func(t2(s))</pre>
</div>
<p>　　再将所有的尾递归发生的地方改为对参数的改变(也是是看成是状态改变)</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_circle(s):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
            retrurn f(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">return func(t(s))</span>
            s =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
            retrurn f2(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">return func(t2(s))</span>
            s = t2(s)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　以上就改完了，</p>
<p>　　对于之前sum函数，我们也来这样变动一下:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sum(r, n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> sum(r+n, n-1)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　套上死循环，注意最后改成else</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sum_circle(r, n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> sum(r+n, n-1)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　再把尾递归的地方改为状态转换</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sum_circle(r, n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            r, n </span>= (r+n, n-1)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　上面就转换成功了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　<span style="font-size: 18pt"><strong>尾调用优化</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　我们来看一个C语言的例子</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">even.c</span>
#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> is_odd(uint64_t n);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> is_even(uint64_t n) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (n == (uint64_t)<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> is_odd(n - (uint64_t)<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">odd.c</span>
#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> is_even(uint64_t n);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> is_odd(uint64_t n) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (n == (uint64_t)<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> is_even(n - (uint64_t)<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">test.c</span>
#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;stdio.h&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> is_even(uint64_t n);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main() {
    uint64_t x </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (uint64_t)10000000000ull;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (is_even(x)) {
        printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%llu is even\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (unsigned <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)x);
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        printf(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%llu is not even\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (unsigned <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)x);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　以上是三个C文件，其实就是判断偶数的is_even和判断奇数的is_odd互相递归，先单独编译成o文件，再链接为可执行文件。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> -c even.c -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o even.o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> -c odd.c -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o odd.o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> -c test.c -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o test.o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> even.o odd.o test.o -o a.out</pre>
</div>
<p>　　执行a.out发现崩溃，符合我们的逾期，它有非常长的运行栈，甚至超过我电脑内存，必然会爆掉。</p>
<p>　　但我们加上-O2优化编译再链接</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> -O2 -c even.c -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o even.o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> -O2 -c odd.c -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o odd.o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> -O2 -c test.c -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o test.o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gcc</span> even.o odd.o test.o -o a.out</pre>
</div>
<p>　　此时执行a.out发现过了几秒之后，打印出</p>
<p>　　10000000000 is even</p>
<p>　　可能会有点疑惑，因为三个文件是单独编译的，之后链接并不存在整体优化，也就是一直无法串通。而is_even和is_odd互相不知道对方是干嘛的。</p>
<p>　　脑洞大开一下，是不是编译器通过名字猜出功能？</p>
<p>　　好吧，虽然想法离谱，但还是试试，把is_even和is_odd名字改成谁也猜不明白的样子，把printf里的内容写成乱码，再做一遍，依然如此，没有崩溃。</p>
<p>　　其实，我们观察一下这里is_even和is_odd的实现，发现它和尾递归很像，它除了彻底退出之外，会全部转化为调用另外一个函数，而尾递归是全部转化为调用自身。</p>
<p>　　我们可以这样想，当转化为另一个调用的时候，原来函数的任何自变量已经没有存在的意义，那么直接覆盖掉就行了。</p>
<p>　　is_even(100)</p>
<p>　　is_odd(99)</p>
<p>　　is_even(98)</p>
<p>　　is_odd(97)</p>
<p>　　...</p>
<p>　　这样一路算下去即可，所以我们只需要保留一组函数调用的状态就可以了，完全不需要压栈。</p>
<p>　　这样调用方式叫尾调用，是比尾递归更一般的形式。</p>
<p>　　当函数判断到自己存在尾调用的地方，直接从运行栈上把自己的那部分弹出，修改成新的函数然后压入即可。如此，就不会在反复调用的时候导致栈不断增长。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　<strong><span style="font-size: 18pt">更一般的情况</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　我们来考虑阶乘，定义</p>
<p>　　$n!=\prod_{i=1}^{n}{i}$</p>
<p>　　用尾递归实现:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factorial(n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factorial_iter(r, n):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> factorial_iter(r * n, n - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> factorial_iter(1, n)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　但很容易就写成以下的写法，</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factorial(n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> 1
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> factorial(n - 1) * n</pre>
</div>
<p>　　以上这一段不是尾递归/尾调用，因为它不是完全转化为一个函数调用，这样的写法一般情况下执行会拖着一个运行栈。</p>
<p>　　这一段代码符合以下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(s):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f(s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> g(func(t(s)), s)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　其中cond、f、g、t都是函数，实际上，上面最后一段阶乘写法，换成这样写可以是</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factorial(n):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0)(n):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)(n)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> a, b : a * b)(factorial((<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : n - 1)(n)), n)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　也就是，这里</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>cond = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
f </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
g </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> a, b : a *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b
t </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : n - 1</pre>
</div>
<p>　　我们看看这样的写法能不能有机会优化</p>
<p>　　计算过程也是一开始一直计算func的参数</p>
<p>　　func(s)</p>
<p>　　g(func(t(s)), s)</p>
<p>　　g(g(func(t(t(s))), t(s)), s)</p>
<p>　　g(g(g(func(t(t(t(s)))), t(t(s))), t(s)), s)</p>
<p>　　g(g(g(g(func(t(t(t(t(s))))), t(t(t(s)))), t(t(s))), t(s)), s)</p>
<p>　　...</p>
<p>　　直到发现一个$t^n(s)$满足cond，然后从最里层一层层的计算出来</p>
<p>　　但此时最里一层是$g(f(t^n(s)), t^(n-1)(s))$</p>
<p>　　虽然$t^n(s)$我们现在是知道了，但通过$t^n(s)$推出$t^(n-1)(s)$需要t函数存在反函数才行</p>
<p>　　如果t有反函数T</p>
<p>　　那么&nbsp;$t^(n-1)(s) = T(t^n(s))$</p>
<p>　　于是一切就可以推回去了，从里往外一层层的上去就可以求值了。</p>
<p>　　我们仔细来写一下，</p>
<p>　　对于</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(s):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f(s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> g(func(t(s)), s)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　如果函数t有反函数T，那么以下优化是存在的</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt(s):
    rec_depth </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond(arg):
        rec_depth </span>+= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        arg </span>= t(arg) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">每一次都通过t转化一下</span>
    ret =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f(arg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(rec_depth):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">一层层的往外算</span>
        arg =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> T(arg)
        ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g(ret, arg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ret</pre>
</div>
<p>　　如果函数t不存在反函数，那我们只能把</p>
<p>　　t(s)、t(t(s))...</p>
<p>　　这些全都记下来，才能推出来了</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt_t_no_inv(s):
    arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s
    arg_list </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    arg_list.append(arg) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">过程中全部压进栈</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond(arg):
        arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t(arg)
        arg_list.append(arg) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">过程中全部压进栈</span>
    ret =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f(arg_list.pop())
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arg_list:
        arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arg_list.pop()
        ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g(ret, arg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ret</pre>
</div>
<p>　　我们测试一下，就以阶乘的例子</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>cond = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : n ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
f </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
g </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> a, b : a *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b
t </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : n - 1

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(s):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f(s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g(func(t(s)), s)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">t的反函数</span>
T = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> n : n + 1
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt(s):
    rec_depth </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond(arg):
        rec_depth </span>+= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        arg </span>= t(arg) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">每一次都通过t转化一下</span>
    ret =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f(arg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(rec_depth):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">一层层的往外算</span>
        arg =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> T(arg)
        ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g(ret, arg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt_t_no_inv(s):
    arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s
    arg_list </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    arg_list.append(arg) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">过程中全部压进栈</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond(arg):
        arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t(arg)
        arg_list.append(arg) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">过程中全部压进栈</span>
    ret =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f(arg_list.pop())
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arg_list:
        arg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arg_list.pop()
        ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g(ret, arg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    a </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(i)
    b </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt(i)
    c </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt_t_no_inv(i)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> a == b ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(i, a)</pre>
</div>
<p>　　我们发现对于0~99，三者计算结果一样，并没有触发assert异常。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　<span style="font-size: 18pt"><strong>多个条件分支的更一般场合</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　如果分支很多，超过两个，比如如下这样</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(s):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f1(s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g1(func(t1(s)), s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f2(s)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond4(s):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g2(func(t2(s)), s)
    ...</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　怎么办呢？</p>
<p>　　其实，只是比刚才那个复杂了一点点而已，我们可以考虑如下变形方式：</p>
<p>　　我们还是假设t1/t2...有反函数T1/T2...</p>
<p>　　第一步,先填写成这样：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt(s):
    rec_depth </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># BEGIN func函数体##</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f1(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g1(func(t1(s)), s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f2(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond4(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g2(func(t2(s)), s)
        ...
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># END func函数体##</span>
        rec_depth += 1
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(rec_depth):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># BEGIN func函数体##</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f1(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g1(func(t1(s)), s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f2(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond4(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g2(func(t2(s)), s)
        ...
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># END func函数体##</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ret</pre>
</div>
<p>　　上下两个循环中都填入func的函数体</p>
<p>　　</p>
<p>　　第二步，对上面那个func函数体做以下改造：</p>
<p>　　遇到结束的分支，改为ret = 返回值，然后break跳出循环</p>
<p>　　而递归下去的分支，改成s = t(s), t是这里s转换下去的那个函数</p>
<p>　　而对下面的那个func函数体，</p>
<p>　　遇到结束的分支，改为pass</p>
<p>　　而递归下去的分支，改为s = T(s)之后再接上ret = g(ret, s)</p>
<p>　　比如上面经过这样的修改则是</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func_opt(s):
    rec_depth </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># BEGIN func函数体##</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
            ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f1(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
            s </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t1(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
            ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f2(s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond4(s):
            s </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t2(s)
        ...
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># END func函数体##</span>
        rec_depth += 1
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(rec_depth):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># BEGIN func函数体##</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond1(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">pass</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond2(s):
            s </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> T1(s)
            ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g1(ret, s)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond3(s):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">pass</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cond4(s):
            s </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> T2(s)
            ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g2(ret, s)
        ...
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># END func函数体##</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ret</pre>
</div>
<p>　　这样，就改造好了，这样递归就改成了循环，可以去构造实例来验证。</p>
<p>　　至于t1/t2...如果有不存在反函数，需要存下来的地方，也可以自己写一写，此处不再实现。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>上一节：</p>
